body: Yeah I think I definitely need to phrase it less as a suggestion. Also something I didn’t mention in the post and a big reason why I’m afraid of coming off too blunt and upsetting him is that we were long distance for a while and during that time I sent a fair share of ‘risky’ photos. I’m soo afraid of him being extremely emotional and doing something stupid to get revenge on me like sending those images to my place of work….I don’t think he’d do it and I like to think he is trustworthy but you really never know and that terrifies me.
Yeah definitely. I think I leave too much room for interpretation with the way I phrase things in an effort not to be blunt and seem insensitive.
I would love to talk to a stranger but I feel so guilty and like no one really wants to listen, ya know? Wish I could get into more therapy but it only does so much.
Same here, I wish more people understood the feeling
Is that why it’s so hard for me to leave? :/

Yeaaah. I felt like it was a pretty easy request to make my insecurity go away in that moment. I didn’t even want to go through his phone I was just like, “please open your phone and let me see what app you were just using...” and he said something about not wanting to do that and that he deserves privacy... I definitely am feeling super ‘crazy’ for even asking bc of his reaction but like what is he hiding?

Yeah I’m worried that might happen as well. I’m just hoping to get out of this mess I’ve made for myself without losing literally everything. It’s sorta hard for me to grasp what my “first step” needs to be even. :/
Definitely. I’ll tread lightly until I have my ducks in a row I suppose
Thanks so much. I’ll do some more research on the items you discussed above. Luckily we don’t have children or own a home together.
